cases.title: Verify presence of both Classic and Modern themes under theme preferences
cases.description: Navigate to the theme preferences section and verify that both Classic and Modern themes are listed as available options.

cases.title: Verify Classic Theme Visual Display
cases.description: Apply the Classic theme under preferences and verify that its visual appearance matches the reference image.

cases.title: Verify Modern Theme Visual Display
cases.description: Apply the Modern theme within preferences and verify that the user interface is displayed correctly matching the specified reference image.

cases.title: Verify Theme Preferences item exists under View menu
cases.description: Navigate to the View menu and verify that the 'Theme Preferences' item is available and correctly displayed.

cases.title: Verify Get New Themes under View menu
cases.description: Navigate to the View menu and verify that the 'Get New Themes' item is present and available.

cases.title: Verify Classic item under View menu
cases.description: Navigate to the View menu and verify that the 'Classic' item is present and available for selection.

cases.title: Verify Modern item is available under View menu
cases.description: Navigate to the View menu and verify that the 'Modern' item is present and selectable.

opinions.feedback: The proposed test cases adequately cover all the requirements and are testable, distinct, and pose low risk.

analysis.analysis:
R-175: Normal path - verify both Classic and Modern themes are present under theme preferences. Boundary - exactly two themes available.
R-176: Normal path - apply Classic theme and verify visual layout matches the reference image. Ambiguity - specific reference image file not provided.
R-177: Normal path - apply Modern theme and verify visual layout matches the reference image. Ambiguity - specific reference image file not provided.
R-178: Normal path - navigate to View menu and verify 'Theme Preferences' item is available.
R-179: Normal path - navigate to View menu and verify 'Get New Themes' item is available.
R-180: Normal path - navigate to View menu and verify 'Classic' item is available.
R-181: Normal path - navigate to View menu and verify 'Modern' item is available.
